judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation and caching logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, but introduces three `as any` casts (`(Ajv as any)`, `(err as any).dataPath`, `(err.params as any)`), which causes `npm run eslint --max-warnings 0` to fail on `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`. It also compiles static schemas twice at registration time instead of once, and leaves the uncommitted working file `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. Several explicit acceptance criteria are missed: the orchestrator retry test was placed in a custom `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, `example/weather-tool.ts` and the code block in `docs/adding-a-tool.md` still defensively default `location` to `'Unknown'`, and `.specify/spec.md` omits the required statement that the tool-round bound stops retry cycles from spinning.
